999008199.text:
……ということがありまして、レスナさんが僕の呪いを
癒してくれたんです。まだ完全には解けていませんが

localizations.en: ...And that's how Resna helped heal my curse. It's not completely gone yet, but...

999008199.text:
は～……そんな薬まで調合できるなんて
やっぱレスナってすごいんだなぁ……

localizations.en: Wow... Being able to synthesize medicine like that? Resna really is amazing...

999008199.text:
今の話をレスナが聞いていたら、
そんなことはないと謙遜するだろうが……

localizations.en: If Resna heard you say that, she'd probably be modest and say it was nothing special, but...

999008199.text:
彼女は紛れもなくティムの命の恩人だ。
受けた恩はなんとしてでも返したい

localizations.en: She saved Tim's life, plain and simple. I want to repay that debt no matter what.

999008199.text:
うん。それにレスナさんについてけば
色んな外の世界を見られそうだしね！

localizations.en: Yeah. Plus, if I stick with Resna, I'll get to see all sorts of new places!

999008199.text:
それは確かに。保証できちゃう。
アタシも出会ってから知らない世界ばかり見てるし

localizations.en: That's for sure. I can guarantee it. Ever since I met her, I've been seeing new things constantly.

999008199.text:
知らない海、知らない場所、知らない敵……
色々経験を積んで、強くなりたい

localizations.en: Unknown seas, unknown places, unknown enemies... I want to gain experience and get stronger.

999008199.text: 今まで迷惑かけた分、兄さんを守れるくらいに

localizations.en: Strong enough to protect Geron and make up for all the trouble I've caused.

999008199.text:
ああ……ティムよ、なんと嬉しいことを
言ってくれるんだ、お前は……

localizations.en: Tim... What wonderful words. You have no idea how happy that makes me...

999008199.text:
大切な家族を守りたい、そのために強くなりたい……
分かる。私も姉様を守りたいし

localizations.en: Wanting to protect precious family, wanting to get stronger for that... I totally understand. I want to protect my sister too.

999008199.text:
うんうん、アタシはベップに守られてるよね。
もうちょっと、自分でしっかりしないとなんだけど

localizations.en: Yeah, yeah, Bepp's always looking out for me. I really should stand on my own two feet.

999008199.text:
どんな姉様だとしても、姉様のベップはどこまでも
ずっと一緒にいるから

localizations.en: No matter what kind of person you end up being, I'll always be by your side.

999008199.text:
素敵な姉妹ですね。その想いの強さがあれば、
きっと離れることはないと思いますよ！

localizations.en: You two have such a wonderful bond. With feelings that strong, I'm sure you'll never be apart!

999008199.text:
む。兄弟愛の強さなら俺も負けはしない。
ティムには俺がついている

localizations.en: Hmph. When it comes to sibling love, no one can top me. Tim has me by his side.

999008199.text:
なんかティムを見てると
他人とは思えなくなってくるんだけど……

localizations.en: Looking at Tim, I'm starting to feel like he's not quite a stranger anymore...

999008199.text:
ティム、別に敬語じゃなくてもいいからね？
親しみやすいアルビちゃんで売り出してもいるし

localizations.en: Tim, you don't have to be so formal with me, you know? I'm going for that friendly, approachable Alvie vibe.

999008199.text:
わ、分かりました。とはいえ難しいな。言葉遣い、
交じるかもしれません。あぁもう交じってる

localizations.en: O-okay. Though it's kinda hard. My speech might get mixed up. Ah, it's already happening.

999008199.text:
仲が良すぎるのも大変かもだけど、
やっぱり兄弟仲がいいのが一番よ

localizations.en: Being too close might have its challenges, but getting along with your siblings is still for the best.

999008199.text:
こっちはいつの間にやら９人兄弟の一員だけど、
最近はドンパチ兄弟ゲンカしてるし？

localizations.en: Here I am, suddenly part of a family of nine, and lately we've been fighting each other left and right.

999008199.text:
記憶にないのに兄弟って言われて、
どんな感じ？

localizations.en: How does it feel being told you have siblings when you can't remember them?

999008199.text:
向こうは知ってて、こっちは知らないってのは
やっぱりなんか変な感じね

localizations.en: They know me, but I don't know them... It's definitely strange.

999008199.text:
たとえば私はナナ……７番目だから
４番目のシトリンは姉……兄？

localizations.en: For example, I'm Nana... number seven, so number four, Citrine, is my older... sister? Brother?

999008199.text:
ん？　なになに？
僕のこと、呼んだ？

localizations.en: Hm? What's this? Did you call for me?

999008199.text:
シトリン、あんたって私のお姉ちゃんなの？
それともお兄ちゃん？

localizations.en: Citrine, are you my big sister? Or big brother?

999008199.text: ふっふっふ。さあね？

ダメダメ、こいつに聞いてもまともに返ってこない。
この前は「性別はシトリンさ」とか言ってたし

localizations.en: No good—asking this one won't get you anywhere. Last time, they said something like 'my gender is Citrine.'

999008199.text: 謎があったほうが人生、ちょっぴり面白いんだって

localizations.en: Life's a little more fun with some mystery, don't you think?

999008199.text:
たび重なる記憶喪失で自分に謎が増えまくってる
私の前で、よくそれを言い切れるわね……

localizations.en: You have the nerve to say that in front of me when I'm drowning in mysteries about myself after repeated memory loss...

999008199.text:
そういえば見た感じ、アンタら九偉人の中で
一番お姉さんなのはイェルカっぽいけど、違うのよね？

localizations.en: Speaking of which, from what I can see, Jelka seems like the oldest among you Nine, but that's not actually the case, is it?

999008199.text: そう、違う。上に長男と長女がいる

localizations.en: Right, it's not. There's an eldest brother and eldest sister above us.

999008199.text: 名前、なんか１からもじったっぽいけど違った？

localizations.en: Wait, their names are based on numbers, right? Wasn't it something derived from 'one'?

999008199.text:
ああ、あれは勝手に名乗ってるだけ。
元の名前はサンだって言ってた

localizations.en: Ah, that's just a name Jelka made up. The original name was San.

999008199.text:
まあサンもといイェルカは、実際一番上っぽくしてて、
こっちに世話焼いてくるけどね

localizations.en: Well, San—or rather, Jelka—does act the most like an older sibling and looks after us.

999008199.text:
それがうざったいときもあるけど……
なんだかんだ、かわいがってくれてるし嫌いじゃないよ

localizations.en: Sometimes it's annoying, but... she's pretty caring, and I don't dislike it.

999008199.text:
３番目だからサン……ってことなのよね。
それじゃ１番目と２番目の二人は？

localizations.en: She's the third, and her name 'San' reflects that... I think get it. Then what about numbers one and two?

999008199.text: あの二人は……まぁ、ね。アレだから

localizations.en: Those two are... well, you know. They're... like that.

999008199.text: は？　アレだからってなに？

アレはアレ！　はい、それより魔物の出る海域だよ！
襲ってくるから警戒しよ！

localizations.en: Like that! Anyway, we're entering monster-infested waters! They'll attack, so stay alert!

999008199.text: くっ、魔物か。来い、怖くないったら怖くない！

localizations.en: Tch, monsters. Come at me—I'm not scared! Not scared at all!

999008199.text:
あからさまに話を逸らした……
どんな兄と姉なのかしら……

localizations.en: That was an obvious subject change... What kind of siblings are they, I wonder...
